question: What parts of the body should be saturated with the fluid in this practice?
premises: A fluid is used in the practice
This fluid should color or saturate the body
The saturation extends to all hair pores and so forth
inference: One should saturate the entire body, beginning with the hair pores, with the fluid.
plain_english: O beloved, one should saturate everything, beginning with the hair pores, with the fluid.
